plan.title: Single-Stage RFQ Empty Award Option Validation

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and establish the initial award-option state needed to reach the RFQ create screen.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
